statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The monitoring was ordered to correlate intermittent symptoms with potential arrhythmias
The monitoring was ordered to assess the efficacy of current rate-control management
The claim was denied based on reason code CO-197
The denial was because required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date
